The applicant has filed this First application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Kotwali, District Sheopur in connection with crime No. 09/2023 registered for t h e offence punishable under Section 376 (2) (n), 366, 384, 506 of IPC.
Allegations against the applicant/accused, in short, are that he committed rape upon the prosecutrix so also took Rs. 4,70,000/- from her by black mailing her.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated.
He further argued that applicant is the only earning member of his family.

sentences.text: The prosecutrix is a major woman and allegedly she was sexually assaulted from 09/11/2018 to November, 2022.
However, the FIR was lodged on 08/01/2023.
The prosecutrix has failed to explain inordinate delay in lodging the FIR.
At the most, this is a case of consensual sexual relationship.
The applicant is in custody since 09/01/2023.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet has since been filed and further custodial interrogation of the applicant may not be required.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Sheopur.
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in Signature Notthe sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two local solvent Verified Signed by: SANJAY sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
